artifact_kind: source-grounded organization proposal and file ledger
scope: Every tracked Go file and package under agentplane, including tests, generated tracked files, fixtures, commands and experiments. All top-level Agentplane areas remain visible as context. This is a target-organization proposal, not a claim that proposed APIs or directories are implemented.

freshness.go_or_proto_delta: Since 7867f81780, #16354, #16357, #16358, #16361, #16364, #16370, #16375, #16378 and #16380 changed Go or protos: 4 Go files added (`runner_gateway/dispatcher/service_attribution.go`, `dispatcher/service_admission_integration_test.go`, `runner_gateway/environments/service_svid_test.go`, `notification_service/testing/process_fixture/driver_test.go` in a new test-only package), 61 edited, none removed or moved; `session_dispatcher.proto` changed one field comment (#16380). #16364 added Dispatcher migration `00019`; #16357 added central sampler migration `0018`. No track landed whole.
freshness.interpretation: Landed work items are removed, not listed as done. Moved and new files are reclassified at their new paths; packages that no longer hold Go files (`action_service` root, `app/internal/proxy`, `policy` root) left the ledger.

runtime_facts_split.finding: The per-Sandbox Lease is also the Gateway's connection Lease: claiming it allocates the ConnectionEpoch that fences Gateway unary, admission and Executor calls and guards EndpointSlice publication. Calling the current WatchState from the Controller would replace the Gateway's epoch.
runtime_facts_split.plan_change: gateway-runtime-lease-removal became runtime-facts-off-lease (stage 1: move fact readers, then delete fact publication and the codec). Deleting the connection Lease moved to gateway-replica-ownership (stage 5), which must name the replacement call fence and EndpointSlice owner.
runtime_facts_split.operator_decision: 2026-11-14 02:36 UTC, on the card "Let any Gateway replica call a Runtime, dropping the Lease's call epoch?" the operator chose "Any replica, no epoch": the Runtime fences only by incarnation and boot ID; the connection Lease, its epoch and the -control EndpointSlice go; callers use the Gateway Service. Plan: new stage 1 item gateway-connection-lease-removal; gateway-replica-ownership narrows to the Dispatcher's ownership Lease and the Gateway's name.

verified: `runner_gateway/main.go` builds the Dispatcher, EnvironmentService, the lifecycle manager, the Runtime proxy and the Executor into one process and registers them on one gRPC server.
`dispatcher.ProxyRunner` dials `sandboxapi.ControlServiceTargetTemplate()` for every Runtime call, including from the same Pod.
`dispatcherAccount` proves the delivery token belongs to the serving Pod (TokenReview Pod name and UID, ServiceAccount); `internal/gateway` admits Runtime mutations only from that account.
`lifecycle.Manager` reserves the Dispatcher-database budget only for automatic wakes (`RequestWake`); since #16375 explicit resume reserves none (`lifecycle/SPEC.md`).
Automatic wake refuses when `spec.running` is false or `status.suspendedBy` is `Requested`; operator resume may undo a requested stop.
The Sandbox Controller keeps idle timers in memory from its first sighting of the Runtime's `idle-since` and quiesces with `ifIdleSince`; the Runtime aborts if anything arrived since.
Runtime blockers: per Session active turn, pending input and setup; Runtime-wide Admission, ExecutorRelay (open Executor call or session) and Bootstrap.

The Dispatcher README states a central sampler Session bypasses execution-Sandbox readiness and wake; `central_sampler` has no resume or wake call, and its executor retries `Unavailable` until a deadline.

#16311 (draft, plans/environment_service_controller_merge.md) kept the Gateway for Dispatcher and proxy and had the controller call back for the budget; #16318 (draft, stacked on it) added that controller-only budget RPC.

Outside `runner_gateway/`, 43 Go files import the generated `dispatcher/api/session` package and 14 TypeScript files import its generated code; `agentplane/app/app_service.proto` imports the `.proto` file. The proto package is `agentplane.runner_gateway.dispatcher`.

Outside `runner_gateway/`, only `agentplane/action_service/session_delegation/dispatcher_integration_test.go`, `agentplane/action_service/session_delegation/dispatcher_integration_testmain_test.go` import `dispatcher` or `migrations`, and only `agentplane/action_service/orchestration_v1/fixture_test.go` imports `environments` or `environments/lifecycle`.
At the pin `agentplane/environments/` holds only `v1/environment_service.proto` and its BUILD file; `agentplane/session_dispatcher/` does not exist.
`sandbox_controller` is referenced by Bazel label from `devinfra/ci/image_targets.json`, `agentplane/system_tests/k3s/defs.bzl` and `cluster/cdk8s/agentplane/BUILD.bazel` (`:settings`).
After #16351 the Dispatcher imports `environmentaccess` for `bind_session` (checked on its head, still open at 1dc2f4b219).

The Sandbox CRD's CEL rule admits a `spec.identity` change only before the first status report or at `status.stopStage: Stopped` (`sandboxes/api/types.go`); a running incarnation keeps its credential's subject. The Runtime refuses to re-admit a Session with a different execution Identity, but does not compare retained Sessions with its own credential.
